name: Compact home uses real unique/copy/deck statistics and three mobile tiles
Mobile history opens recorded result, nested card and closes back to row without credit
Private receipts refuse another user and history is no-store
Extension progression links to only missing cards of the selected real set
Profile preferences persist independently and installation guidance is accessible
Preferences wait for identity and never write the guest key for an authenticated account
Home history profile progress are responsive at seven viewports
Light theme pages and browser theme color follow the chosen preference
Manifest assets and real service worker cache only public allowlist
Offline private navigation shows generic fallback without personal content
Install prompt UI and iOS manual guidance use supported paths
Update UI refuses an unconfirmed intent and requires explicit activation
No JavaScript errors or extra rewards across mobile pages
